sourceText:
Sour Cream Cheese Cake!!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Friday, November 11, 2011 - 5:13pm

Ingredients




16 oz. sour cream
8 oz. cream cheese
¼ cup corn starch
1 tsp. baking powder
1 cup sugar
Zest of 1 lemon
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 tsp. vanilla
3 eggs
Crumb Crust:
1 ½ cups fine crumbs – such as vanilla cookies or graham crackers
6 tablespoons butter
4 tablespoons brown sugar

Preparation

1 For Pie: 2 In a mixing bowl combine the corn starch, baking powder and sugar. Add the sour cream, cream cheese, eggs, lemon juice, lemon zest and vanilla and mix well. 3 Crumb Crust: 4 Melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat and add the fine crumbs and sugar and blend well. Place the crumb mixture in a pie plate and press down to form. 5 Bake in oven for about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool a few minutes before adding the batter. 6 When the pie crust is cooled for a few minutes add the batter. 7 Bake for 35-40 minutes or until toothpick test comes out clean. 8 Cool before serving.
